subject: RODBC connection to an Microsoft Access Database fails when deployed

messages.author: e54723a703037086
messages.subject: RODBC connection to an Microsoft Access Database fails when deployed
parts:
Hello,
I may Shiny app pulls data from an MS Access database to make some graphs. The connection is made with RODBC :

odbcConnect("DSN_name")

This works well locally, but the app fails to make the database connection when deployed. I get the following error message:

Warning in odbcDriverConnect("DSN=WQSYNTH") :
[RODBC] ERROR: state IM002, code 0, message [unixODBC][Driver Manager]Data source name not found, and no default driver specified


My access database is only 12mb.

Does anyone know why this is happening. The Data source name is found when run locally, so why not when deployed?

Thanks for your time.

Cheers,
YD.

Is there another way to just point to the relative path where the Access database resides?
